title: VIBTOBIlab/scalemethyltobi pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for samples.csv provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and can only contain letters, digits and dashes

libName.errorMessage: Library name can only contain letters, digits and dashes

barcodes.errorMessage: Barcodes must be well coordinates or ranges separated by ';', e.g. 1A01-1H12;2A01-2H12

threshold.errorMessage: Threshold must be a positive integer (unique reads per cell)

split.errorMessage: split must be true or false

fastq_1.errorMessage: Read 1 fastq file (genomic read): path without spaces ending in '.fastq.gz' or '.fq.gz'; relative paths are relative to the samplesheet

fastq_2.errorMessage: Read 2 fastq file (Tn5 barcode and genomic read): path without spaces ending in '.fastq.gz' or '.fq.gz'; relative paths are relative to the samplesheet

index_1.errorMessage: Index 1 (i7) fastq file: path without spaces ending in '.fastq.gz' or '.fq.gz'; relative paths are relative to the samplesheet

index_2.errorMessage: Index 2 (i5) fastq file: path without spaces ending in '.fastq.gz' or '.fq.gz'; relative paths are relative to the samplesheet
